clips.title: The story
paras: Bloodfeather harpies harry Oracle Glade in northwestern Teldrassil. The sacred woodland holds the ancient Oracle Tree and Teldrassil’s first and most potent moonwell.

Between Darnassus and Wellspring Lake, the Oracle Glade shelters a place of communion with nature. At its heart stands the ancient Oracle Tree, magically nurtured, its great boughs shaped like an eagle perched atop a bear. Nearby lies the first and most potent of Teldrassil’s sacred moonwells, bright with Elune’s grace. The Circle of the Ancients and the Oracle Tree watch over the island boughs. The tree sheds bark marked with messages for Archdruid Fandral Staghelm about the World Tree’s health.

Bloodfeather harpies have made roosts in the glade’s high branches. The aggressive avian scavengers threaten the sacred tree and harass traveling druids, disturbing the moonwell’s quiet. Sentinels from Darnassus struggle to drive them out. As you pass through the northern boughs, tread carefully; harpies strike swiftly near their roosts.
